prompts.text: factory_dispatch-style prompt for GardnerTimingRecovery; isolated worktree; verify vs GR or quarantine.

quarantine_reason: RETRY 2026-08-27: the 2026-08-06 root cause (TED precision, the >>1 halving) was WRONG. Ablation on the same channel/metric: removing the >>1 reaches only BER 0.0122 (2/50 failing); the actual defect is an UNBOUNDED PHASE ACCUMULATOR (no modulo, phase wraps int16 at 32298 and inverts the interpolation - the loop was SLIPPING, not jittering). With a modulo-1 counter + full-precision MULQ TED + GR-derived PI gains the Q15 DSP reaches BER 0 on all 50 selection cases and 200 held-out cases in a bit-exact ISA model. It still does not ship on an ON-CHIP INTEGRATION wall: one cell cannot reliably be both the block's external-egress cell and an internal feedback-trigger source (four build passes contend for its WRITE/JUMP words), so period_relay never executes and the PI never runs.
notes:
QUARANTINE (needs_human), 2 attempts, autonomous verdict. poc. KEY FINDING: the block's OLD 'green' tests validated against a synthetic 2sps stimulus GR ITSELF cannot lock (BER ~0.45) -- i.e. it was tuned outside GR's operating regime; per-block GR-equivalence exposed it. New test PROVES both sides on the same channel (GR locks BER 0; DUT does not, reference AND on-chip) + leaves an xfail tripwire to promote if ever fixed. Extends the documented Gardner 4-PAM limit to 2-level BPSK on a Nyquist channel. A paper data point, not a hidden failure.

RETRY (2026-08-27, +540,340 output tokens, 412 turns, ~70 min): SECOND attempt, 0 human interventions. Outcome still QUARANTINE, but the recorded diagnosis was corrected with measurements rather than argument - a paper data point in its own right. The Q15 signal-processing question is SOLVED (BER 0, full offset sweep, 200 held-out cases, bit-exact ISA model); the wall moved from 'the substrate cannot do Gardner in Q15' to a specific, named build-integration conflict. NO BLOCK SOURCE WAS COMMITTED - the repo must not carry a block whose reference disagrees with its own silicon. Generalizable lesson recorded: when a quarantine names a PRECISION root cause, ablate before believing it; precision defects degrade gracefully, and a one-line check of an accumulator's max magnitude against int16 range finds a wrap in minutes.
